tool_args.rationale: The added horizon measurements reveal long-term reversal and constrain the slow adaptation timescale. Fit all five parameters numerically and test the specified sink-coupled law on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot and three long-horizon measurements now span the relevant timescales and provide more observations than the five fitted parameters.
The pilot shows a sink-gradient dependence, and the recalled sink-coupled mechanism explicitly incorporates it.
The observed sink dependence and long-horizon reversal favor the sink-coupled adaptation mechanism.
